item.title: U.S. Senate delays the CLARITY Act crypto market-structure bill until after summer recess, missing an August 7 deadline.
BlackRock, Fidelity, Goldman Sachs and Franklin Templeton publicly endorse the U.S. CLARITY Act ahead of Senate vote.
Bitcoin- and Ethereum-linked DeFi protocols lose $35 million across three simultaneous bridge attacks.
Triple-A, a Singapore stablecoin payments firm, reports a wallet breach draining 5,280 ETH over two days.
WEMIX suspends network services after a contract breach allows 5.23 million unauthorized stablecoin tokens to be minted.
MiCA compliance costs drive merger and acquisition activity among smaller European crypto firms after the July 1 deadline.
U.S. and UK regulators publish a 10-point roadmap to align tokenized-asset and stablecoin oversight across both markets.
Tether faces a two-year countdown under the GENIUS Act to comply or lose access to U.S. crypto platforms.
FinCEN and OFAC finalize rules bringing GENIUS Act stablecoin issuers under Bank Secrecy Act and sanctions compliance.
BNY Mellon completes a 24/7 U.S. Treasury settlement test using tokenized stablecoin rails, targeting full deployment by 2027.
Circle receives a U.S. national trust bank charter, enabling federally regulated digital-asset custody for institutional clients.
Ostium loses $18 million in an oracle attack where manipulated future-price timestamps triggered automated USDC payouts.
Vanguard Group posts its first head of digital assets role, marking a strategic shift after years of avoiding crypto products.
SEC plans to release its first crypto rule proposal targeting exemptions for startups and digital-asset fundraising activities.
MiCA's July 1 compliance deadline displaced more than 10 million European crypto users from non-compliant platforms.
